parts.text: 表示状态、感觉、情绪、精神活动的动词 常用于一般现在时而不用于进行时。

rows: The sun will appear in the morning.（太阳将在早晨出现。）
I appreciate your help.（我感谢你的帮助。）
I believe in your abilities.（我相信你的能力。）
I feel happy today.（我今天感觉很开心。）
Don't forget your keys.（不要忘记你的钥匙。）
I can't hear what you're saying.（我听不到你在说什么。）
She knows the answer.（她知道答案。）
I like ice cream.（我喜欢冰淇淋。）
She looked tired.（她看起来很累。）
Did you notice the beautiful flowers?（你注意到美丽的花了吗？）
I can't remember his name.（我记不住他的名字。）
The two sisters resemble each other.（这两姐妹长得像。）
I see a beautiful sunset.（我看见美丽的日落。）
What do you think about this idea?（你觉得这个主意怎么样？）
I don't understand the instructions.（我不理解这些说明。）
This book belongs to me.（这本书属于我。）
The team consists of talented players.（这个队由有才华的球员组成。）
This box contains chocolates.（这个盒子里有巧克力。）
She desires success in her career.（她渴望在事业上取得成功。）
He dislikes spinach.（他不喜欢菠菜。）
I hope for a better future.（我希望有一个更好的未来。）
She loves her family.（她爱她的家人。）
What does this word mean?（这个词是什么意思？）
Do you mind if I open the window?（你介意我打开窗户吗？）
I need some rest.（我需要休息。）
She wants a new bicycle.（她想要一辆新自行车。）
I wish you a happy birthday.（祝你生日快乐。）

parts.text: Q:Where did the writer want to go? Did he know the way or not? What did the conductor promise to do?

A:The writer wanted to go to Woodfast Green but as he did not know the way, the conductor promised to tell him where to get off. (but as) “but as” 并不是并列短语, 两者连在一起仅仅是巧合第一句和第二句之间是 “but” 关系, 第二句和第三句之间为 “as” 关系, 所以产生 “but as”。

expand.title: 易混淆词 lose, loose, miss.

headers: lose vt. 失去，丧失，遗失，丢失
loose adj. 松动的，松的，松开的
miss v. 怀念, 思念, 错过，未能…，缺（课等），惦念，想念
rows: Roy has lost his job again. She lost her parents when she was sixteen. If you bet on that horse you will lose your money. （bet on sth 就…打赌）
Servral screws have come loose. （come loose，松了（系动词+adj.）） The handle of this suitcase is very / has come loose.
Hurry or you’ll miss the train. I missed my English lesson.

headers: sth. is lost = sth. is missing
rows: missing boy 失踪了的孩子(不能用 “lost” )

headers: Expect v. 预计…可能发生（或来到），等待，期盼
rows: I expect / I’m expecting to hear from you. 表示等待时往往侧重人的心理。 I’m expecting the bus to arrive in the next ten minutes. My trip took me longer than I expected.
I’m waiting for the next bus.具体在某个地方等
